# Fixtures: synthetic

None of these files was recorded from a live service. They are hand-written to the
response formats the libraries document (`crates/ebc-catalog/tests/fixtures/README.md`
explains the caveats) and only serve to drive the command line offline.

- `openlibrary/etranger.json`: Open Library `api/books` answer for ISBN 9782070360024
  (*L'Étranger*, Albert Camus, Gallimard, Folio). Record identifiers are invented.
- `openlibrary/not-found.json`: Open Library's "unknown ISBN" answer, an empty object.

Images, robots.txt bodies and fixture indexes are generated by the tests themselves
(`tests/cli/common.rs`).
